summary: CEMIG, the Brazilian listed electric utility, filed a routine Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing 32 exhibits, including dividend and interest-on-equity payout notices for fiscal 2025, an executive board composition update, second-quarter 2026 earnings, an S&P upgrade to brAAA, and a hydroelectric concession extension. Disclosed payouts total R$1.548bn, or R$0.541139687 per common/preferred share, with 15% withholding on interest on equity and 10% on certain dividends under Law 15,270/2025. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, price per share, or regulatory clock is present.
